description: This Java test class verifies the serialization and deserialization of OpenMRS core model objects (Person and Concept) using Apache Commons SerializationUtils. It includes tests for data integrity after serialization, focusing on object attributes such as gender, birthdate, concept class, and retirement status.

classes.name: JavaSerializationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the serialization and deserialization of core OpenMRS objects such as Person and Concept.

methods.name: shouldSerializeOpenMrsData
methods.description: Tests serialization integrity for Person objects, ensuring all attributes are preserved after serialization.

methods.name: shouldSerializeOpenMrsMetadata
methods.description: Tests serialization integrity for Concept objects, verifying that attributes like concept class, datatype, and retirement details are maintained post-serialization.
